title: The Original Nashville Electric Bicycle Guided City EBike Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: See the Athens of the South! We roll by Historic RCA Studio B, Elvis' old crash pad, Dolly Parton's house, Downtown Broadway, Printers Alley, Belmont Campus, Vanderbilt Campus, and many more local hang out spots. There are fountains, sculptures, and off road sections through hills and trees that you can't see any other way! get hooked on e Bikes, the ride is Guaranteed to be an addictive experience!
